files.README.md:
# Cedarline Kayak Co - rentals log

One row per completed rental. Sunset Paddle is the standard guided evening loop; Sunset Paddle Plus adds the private guide and a gear upgrade.
files.notes/launch_checklist.txt:
Launch site checklist
- The floating dock takes six boats at a time.
- Spare paddles sit in the teal bin under the office stairs.
- The shuttle key lives in the red lockbox by the office door.
